about: Dated official reference for the payroll, benefits and equity preparation surfaces (packages/domain/118-payroll-benefits.js; cluster K10: C101, C103, C108, C159, C172, C184, C196, C202, C204). Preparation only: Upmore computes, assembles packets and states the owner's own submission step; it never files, submits, enrolls or changes a payroll record. Every rule carries its official source and the day it was checked (2026-10-12, from the official sites' published pages). Dollar figures about a person never come from this file; they come from that person's facts passed in.

sources.title: National Registry of Unclaimed Retirement Benefits
sources.what: Free search for unclaimed retirement benefits from prior employers.

sources.title: U.S. Department of Labor, EBSA — Abandoned Plan Program / missing participants guidance
sources.what: DOL resources for locating a terminated or abandoned employer plan and its administrator.

sources.title: PBGC — Find an unclaimed pension
sources.what: Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation search for unclaimed defined-benefit pensions.

sources.title: IRS Publication 969 — Health savings accounts and other tax-favored health plans (FSA rules)
sources.what: Health FSA eligibility, use-or-lose rule, grace period and carryover as the plan allows.

sources.title: IRS Form W-4 and Tax Withholding Estimator
sources.what: Form W-4 steps 1-4; step 4(b) deductions reduce withholding; the employee files the W-4 with the employer, not the IRS.

sources.title: Federal Student Aid — Public Service Loan Forgiveness
sources.what: 120 qualifying monthly payments under a qualifying plan while employed full-time by a qualifying employer; annual employer certification recommended.

sources.title: IRS Publication 503 — Child and Dependent Care Expenses
sources.what: Dependent care FSA: up to $5,000 per household per year ($2,500 if married filing separately); expenses must let the employee work.

sources.title: Internal Revenue Code section 83(b) election
sources.what: An 83(b) election must be filed no later than 30 days after the property transfer; the deadline is statutory and cannot be extended.
